reason: The plugin primarily executes OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics data analyses through a persistent Python/R kernel, with variable and output inspection, capability discovery, account integration, and live visualization.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过持久化 Python/R 内核运行 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生物信息学分析，并查看变量、输出文件和实时执行过程。
summaries.en: Run OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in DeepSeek Harness through a persistent Python/R kernel, with variable and output inspection and live execution views.

capabilities: Execute Python and R bioinformatics analyses in a persistent kernel
Read kernel variables and generated analysis files
Attach to or spawn a local analysis kernel
Search an installed analysis capability catalog
Support account login for cloud-backed models
Display live execution progress and generated figures
